{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Check format
print(df['status'].value_counts())
print(df['customer_segment'].value_counts())
print(df['customer_age'].value_counts().head(10))  # Check for -1

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if LOYAL segment exists
loyal_exists = 'loyal' in df['customer_segment'].unique()
print(f"LOYAL segment exists: {loyal_exists}")

# Check if completed orders exist
completed_exists = 'completed' in df['status'].unique()
print(f"Completed status exists: {completed_exists}")"}
